Frequently asked questions.

What can you powder coat?

Most metal parts that can withstand the heat of the curing oven. Send a photo and we will confirm.

Do I need to strip it first?

No. Sandblasting removes rust and old coatings before we coat.

Why add zinc?

Zinc corrodes before the steel does. It is a strong choice for metal that lives outside.

Do you mount and balance tires?

Yes. We have a tire changer and wheel balancer at the shop.

Can you coat a railing that is already installed?

It needs to come off so it can be blasted and cured in the oven. Ask us about removal and reinstall.
